title: Context and memory in an agent

items.stem: Your makerspace assistant checks the calendar and then searches a manual in one request. At the second model call, how does the model know what the calendar check returned?

options.text: The program sends the earlier messages and the calendar result again
The model stores each result inside itself between its own calls
The calendar tool writes the result into the model's training data
The model asks the program to reread the calendar each time

items.stem: A student trains on the 3D printer on Monday and returns on Thursday for a new conversation. With no extra work by your team, what does the assistant know on Thursday about Monday's training?

options.text: Everything, because the model learns from each conversation it has
A summary, because the program saves old chats by default
Nothing, because a new session starts with an empty context
Only the date, because dates are kept in the system prompt

items.stem: In one sentence, why is it usually better for the assistant to retrieve a few relevant manual passages with a search tool than to put every manual into the context on every call?

Your assistant answers a question with a laser-cutter setting that is not in the manual. You inspect the call and find the search tool returned a chunk from the wrong manual. What is the most direct reason the answer was wrong?

options.text: The model reasoned from the text it was handed, which was wrong
The model forgot the right manual that it had learned earlier
The context window was too small to hold any manual
The notes store had not been saved at the end of the session

items.stem: Name two details you would store in a note about a student so a later session can use them, and say how the later session gets them in front of the model.
